semiconductor_relevance: High — Justek develops and manufactures precision motion systems that are critical for semiconductor production equipment.
summary: Justek specializes in the development and manufacturing of linear motors, rotary direct-driven motors, servo drivers, multi-axis controllers, and high precision motion stages. These technologies are essential for enhancing the performance and efficiency of semiconductor manufacturing processes.
